info.name: Microsoft Outlook Microsoft Graph Mail API
info.description:
API for accessing Outlook email messages, mail folders, and attachments through Microsoft Graph. Provides full CRUD operations on messages, mail folder management, attachment handling, and message actions such as send, reply, forward, copy, and move.

Contact Support:
 Name: Microsoft Graph Support
